key_insight: The paper builds a large, spin-polarized database of stable halide double perovskites, revealing thousands of tunable candidates with visible-range gaps and a smaller subset with half-metallic behavior.
engineering_relevance: This dataset helps screen magnetic and optoelectronic perovskites for solar cells, photocatalysis, and radiation detection by linking composition to electronic structure and bonding.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT for spin-polarized DOS across Cs2BB'X6 compounds
Stability filtering using the τ tolerance factor of Bartel et al.
Lobster bonding analysis plus UMAP and an interactive exploration app
evidence_signal: The database covers more than 2,500 compounds, including 719 with visible-range band gaps and 118 with half-metallic character.
watch_item: Stability is predicted by a descriptor-based filter and the results are computational, so experimental synthesis and defect effects still need validation.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
